summary: Assembled a bounded cycle-17 evidence checkpoint with exact source snapshots, original native captures and receipts, the accepted corrected-cwd review, and the fresh E2304 receipt/log. The package is frozen for independent file-only audit; no Git stage, commit, export, publication, or deployment was performed.

checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-site.tes.change: One 19-line renderer-tree regression for anonymous/authenticated × closed/open states.

included_evidence.native_solves: Epoch 00-05 bundles, solve JSON, and root command records copied byte-exact; native state, spec, registry, next-packet and root policy snapshots plus process notes included.
included_evidence.probe_evidence: Both E2301/E2302 bounded directory-recovery probes, source/FLOW/prospective and original captures; E2302 pre-execution source-only result is separately labeled.
included_evidence.red_green: E2303 actual first-case RED, focused 1/1 GREEN, full public-site 16/16, full controller 61/61; all original captures retained.
included_evidence.independent_review: R2303 wrong-cwd AMEND and zero-test captures preserved separately from accepted R2303B corrected-cwd 1/1 pass.
included_evidence.canonical_build: E2304 original stdout/stderr/UTC/exit/signal, plus only the fresh site.receipt.json and site.log, preserving both output files' mode 0555.

qualifications: E2301/E2302 falsified a directory recovery defect; no directory implementation change was made.
E2303 raw RED says the actual attribute was undefined; its JSON result records null because undefined is not representable in JSON.
The E2303 GREEN prospective predicted skipped tests incorrectly; actual raw output reports zero skips in all three runs.
R2303 used the wrong working directory, exited before target loading and registered zero tests; it is a harness AMEND, not a product/test failure. R2303B is the accepted corrected-cwd review.
E2304 targeted 137 HH tests overlap the 292 full-suite tests and are not additive. Receipt sourceInputs contain the renderer but no public-site.test.mjs entry.
All UI observations are synthetic emitted-tree evidence only; no browser DOM, computed accessible name, keyboard, screen-reader, human, backend, real account, email, deployment or publication claim.
The native state snapshot records E2305 running during package preparation and is historical, not live post-finish state.
Two E2305 copy attempts referenced a nonexistent destination and failed before the target copy; the exact copy was then completed. No source or previously copied payload was overwritten.
next_gate: Independent file-only audit of the exact manifest, source snapshots/diff, raw captures and full modes, native provenance, accepted R2303B review, and E2304 receipt/log bindings; then root decision.
